newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ryoden buys luxury HK development.
newsitem.headline: Ryoden buys luxury HK development.

text.p: Ryoden Development Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to buy a luxury residential development in Hong Kong from an independent third party for HK$278 million.
The development, at No 3 Tung Shan Terrace in Stubbs Road, Mid-levels, would be financed by the group's internal resources and a bank loan, Ryoden said in a statement.
The 20,000 sq ft site, to be renamed Hillsdale Garden, has a total gross floor area of 43,200 sq ft.
It has three blocks of three-storied apartment buildings with 36 flats ranging from 911 sq ft to 1,526 sq ft.
